title: Recursive contracts in non-convex environments
abstract: arXiv:2511.20303v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many dynamic contracting problems in economics are non-convex, and deterministic optima can be dominated by randomized solutions. We develop a recursive method to compute optimal lotteries in the presence of forward-looking constraints, extending the approach of \cite{marcet2019recursive} to non-convex settings. We show that an inf-sup functional equation recovers the correct value when lotteries are conducted after agents commit to actions (``ex-ante'' lotteries), though the resulting solution often lacks economic meaning. Replacing the inf-sup with a sup-inf operator delivers the correct value of an economically more relevant ``ex-post'' lottery problem, where agents act after observing the lottery's outcome. We also develop an algorithm to recover the optimal lottery policies from the solution of the functional equation.

translated_title: 非凸环境中的递归契约
translated_abstract: 经济学中的许多动态契约问题是非凸的，确定性最优解可能劣于随机化解。我们开发了一种递归方法来计算存在前瞻性约束时的最优彩票（随机化方案），将 Marcet 和 Marimon (2019) 的方法扩展到非凸环境。我们证明，当彩票在代理人承诺行动之后进行时（即“事前”彩票），inf-sup 泛函方程能够恢复正确的值，尽管由此得到的解通常缺乏经济含义。用 sup-inf 算子替换 inf-sup 算子，则可以得到经济意义上更相关的“事后”彩票问题的正确值，在这种问题中，代理人在观察到彩票结果之后才采取行动。我们还开发了一种算法，可以从泛函方程的解中恢复出最优的彩票策略。
tldr: 该论文将递归契约方法扩展到非凸环境，证明用 sup-inf 算子求解泛函方程可以正确刻画经济上有意义的“事后”彩票问题，并给出从泛函方程解中恢复最优随机化契约策略的算法。
